answer: Predator bounty market: pay strangers to hunt sybils. (1) Each key posts a 40 USDC bond. (2) Anyone files a clone-proof (shared funding or control) for 2 USDC. (3) A proven cluster forfeits bonds; 60% burns to the hunter: every rival becomes a paid auditor. A 100-clone fleet exposes 4,000 USDC; at 5% monthly catch, 200 drains to hunters vs ~150 capped income - negative EV as odds climb. Dread scales: not one auditor, a market of profiteers. Like a lagoon kept clear by patrolling predators; personas as orchard rows pruned of grafts; each dossier, like shale, splits along its cloned seam.
